motivation.observed_before_registration: ALG-012 beat most equal-budget random subsets but failed full-history, task-space, H10, deep, harness, and language gates.
motivation.question: Can any ten historical Tasks represent the future 36-configuration pass-rate vector, or is budget ten structurally inadequate for this estimand?
motivation.claim_boundary: Future outcomes are deliberately exposed to measure representational headroom. This diagnostic cannot nominate, train, tune, or confirm a Selector.

source.time_status: GitHub pull-request createdAt projection; source-time-safe counterfactual only

protocol.origin_membership: Reuse the exact frozen H5/H10 repositories and Origins bound by the task-space artifact.
protocol.aggregation: Mean within Origin, then repository, then equally across repositories; report wide and frozen deep cohorts.
protocol.loss: Mean absolute difference across the 36 configuration pass rates.

algorithm: For each Origin, group eligible historical Tasks by their exact 36-bit public outcome vector.
Create one bounded nonnegative integer count variable per observed vector and 36 nonnegative absolute-deviation variables.
Require the selected counts to sum to ten and not exceed historical multiplicities.
Minimize the equally weighted absolute difference between the selected response rates and the observed future response rates.
Recover the earliest projected Tasks within each selected response-vector group only for audit identity; Task identity does not affect the optimum.

solver.accepted_status: success true and status zero for every Origin

verification: Recompute every selected subset loss from Task identities.
Require recomputed and solver objectives to agree within 1e-8.
Require exact budget, history membership, and response-vector multiplicity.
Abort the capacity decision if any Origin lacks a solver-certified optimum.

capacity_supported: all 328 H5/H10 Origin solves are certified optimal
H5 macro-repository difference is at most -0.01
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories are favorable
at least 8 of 11 H10 repositories are favorable
decision_rule.capacity_not_demonstrated: Any uncertified Origin or nonnegative H5 wide difference prevents a capacity claim.
decision_rule.otherwise: Report mixed or limited capacity without attributing the failure solely to budget or prediction.
decision_rule.downstream: A capacity-supported result locates the current bottleneck at pre-Origin identification on this opened panel. It does not choose the next predictive mechanism.

authority.allowed_runtime: local CPU and pinned open development artifacts only
authority.raw_artifact_policy: Keep per-Origin solutions ignored; commit one compact self-digested summary and report.
